observations: All positions are native 1122 by 1402 source pixels. Brow groups are anatomical: browLeft is canvas-right and browRight canvas-left.
Original brows use the approved desaturated gray-violet style with thin tapered strokes and stylized translucent hair crossings; do not recolor them as white hair or create heavy cosmetic brows.
Eye protection polygons trace actual upper eyelid/crease and eye interiors, not the oversized old eye patch rectangles that also contain eyebrow/forehead pixels.

Protection hair polygons initially cover conservative thick bang interiors. Fine strands crossing individual new eyebrows need separate visual inspection and measured exclusion cores when appropriate.
Brow registration is fixed one-to-one native placement. New source paintings must express the action; no synthetic translation, mirror or warp.
One full bilateral source per action and pose supplies two independently selectable anatomical eyebrow patches. No intensity grades or intermediate drawings are implied.

Initial left-down outerUp was too weak on the far eyebrow; outerUp-v2 is a refinement of that first generated source. Initial left-down down was too deep; down-v2 instead references the original static pose. Both unused first versions remain in provenance with their actual reference chain.

junctionRepair.method: Fixed soft alpha exclusions below the union of original and new eyebrow strokes preserve approved foreground strands already present underneath. No source PNG changes, no drawing, no runtime movement. All three states share each pose mask.
